license_review.scope: Local research-preservation plan for four declared Apache-2.0 checkpoints; not a definitive legal opinion or grant of rights in training datasets.
archive_actions: Keep publisher license declaration tied to the checkpoint revision.
Include applicable license text as a separate provenance asset when the model repo has no LICENSE; never pretend it was an upstream file.
Retain applicable attribution and NOTICE if supplied, and mark later modifications.
Review software component licenses separately; num2words is labelled LGPL, not Apache.

task_requirements_to_resolve: torchvision matched to selected torch build
jinja2>=3.1.0 (declared lower bound, not a security recommendation)
one reviewed video-decoding stack only when container-video input is required
avoid_by_default: flash-attn or downloaded kernels without target-specific need
automatic device_map/Accelerate unless required by the approved profile
shared_runtime.smolvlm_video_template_behavior: At pinned runtime, apply_chat_template supplies DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE when video exists and chat_template is not explicitly supplied. Verify this route before relying on the archived old template.

software_artifacts_metadata_only.role: LGPL source preservation candidate; terms version still to review

security_review.coverage: Two selected public advisories and PyPI release metadata, not a comprehensive vulnerability audit.

advisories.decision: Do not use checkpoint-era 4.x as the standard runtime merely because it is serialized in config.

5.22.1 is outside the listed affected range, but no universal safety conclusion follows and the advisory lists no patched release. Disable remote-code/custom-generation paths and verify the chosen source.

future_execution_controls: Explicit local model paths and local_files_only.
Safetensors path only; no pickle or custom generation code.
Network blocked at OS/container boundary; offline environment flags are supplementary.
No credentials or user files mounted into the test sandbox.
Run each model separately with a fixed memory/time limit after separate execution approval.

metadata_cost.note: Exact listed artifact sizes are logical upstream sizes; shared runtime is not complete and installed footprint is unknown.

acceptance_plan.stage_1: Resolve target OS/CPU-GPU/ABI, matched torch/vision builds, all transitive package hashes and their terms; stop if unresolved.
acceptance_plan.stage_2: After authorization only: verify downloaded payloads and isolate a network-denied environment.
acceptance_plan.stage_3: Run one permitted local fixture per task: finite relative depth; mask shape and frame alignment; guard output parsing; image/video tokens and frame counts for SmolVLM.
acceptance_plan.stage_4: Measure task quality, latency and peak RAM under recorded hardware, clock/power, resolution, batch, context and precision. No benchmark result is claimed here.
acceptance_plan.H: One explicit shared native runtime can avoid storing unrelated backends while retaining the four selected task routes.
acceptance_plan.T: Check four source modules and model-specific processors; then test only after approved acquisition and execution.
acceptance_plan.D: Metadata/source matching passes review; installation, inference and full capacity remain unresolved.
acceptance_plan.C: A checkpoint migration, missing processor dependency, required alternative decoder or license conflict can invalidate the shared profile.
acceptance_plan.U: Hardware/ABI, transitive packages, third-party rights, runtime changes and actual quality are unmeasured; no statistical uncertainty number is fabricated.
